sources.supports: An invalid element in the head makes Google ignore the elements after it.
W3C Nu HTML Checker is the reference HTML validator.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.
